text: On the pilot's proposal to make the course adversary and the cold reader two seats: "would dispatch timing work? one of the key features of orchestrated runs (and adversaries) is physical isolation of context so they don't confirm or celebrate their own work. this means a cold adversary could be added at the end of a dispatch to read the findings. It will not know what happened, and the course adversaries will still be there. this may mean any adversary could be either role, the difference is your dispatch instructions and the timing of dispatch. See agent body = universal, dispatch instructions = targeted to live or cold adversary, timing = context isolation assurance"
